constraints: PASS describes diagnostic execution and consistent populations, never source-completion or semantic equivalence.
Shadow relocation demotions remain unadjudicated. Do not change production scoring or edit source from this queue alone.
Failed commands, missing artifacts, schema mismatches, pre-existing output artifacts and concurrently changed comparison inputs cannot pass.
name: reconstruction-preflight
purpose: Generate fresh normal and shadow relocation reports with input-stability hashes and optional live foundation CLI checks.
usage: Run after a fresh successful ninja build. --out selects the summary; each run retains its own generated reports and logs under the output parent.
